page.security_notice: Custom BBCodes and media embeds are compiled and checked by Flarum's formatter. Before enabling them, review each usage and rendering template; incorrect configurations may prevent posts from being parsed or displayed correctly. When embedding third-party content, also make sure the service source is trustworthy.

groups.bbcode_description: Define custom tag usage, rendering templates, and styles.
groups.media_description: Recognize media links and render embedded content.

confirm.delete: Delete “{name}”? Existing posts will stop using this rendering template, while their source remains editable.
confirm.reset: Reset “{name}” to its defaults? Current unsaved changes will be replaced.

messages.defaults_restored: Defaults restored. Save the template to apply the changes.

fields.rule_type_help: Custom BBCode defines its own usage and template. A built-in template's type cannot be changed.
fields.name_help: Define the rule name. Built-in template names cannot be edited.
fields.tag_help: Lowercase tag without brackets, for example bilibili.
fields.description_help: Describe the purpose of this custom BBCode.
fields.usage_help: s9e BBCode definition, for example [notice color=color]text[/notice]; the color parameter is referenced as @color in the template.
fields.template_help: Safe s9e XSL template. Every referenced @parameter must be declared by the BBCode usage; the rule is compiled and checked before saving. See the s9e templating syntax documentation.
fields.dom_class_help: This class is added to every top-level HTML element output by the rendering template; the style field below uses it as the scope.
fields.css_declarations_help: Enter custom CSS/Less styles, such as color: red;. Child selectors and state selectors are supported.
fields.icon_help: Font Awesome class, for example fas fa-code or fab fa-youtube.
fields.button_label_help: Composer tooltip or dropdown label. Built-in labels can be translated and cannot be edited from here; custom rules use the rule name when empty.
fields.example_help: Used as the initial content when the composer button is clicked without selected text.
fields.example_attributes_help: Each tag is detected from the BBCode usage. Choose a declared value, insert the attribute with an empty value as a prompt, or omit it from the composer insertion.
fields.source_rule_extract_help: Extract content used for embedding from the complete URL. Use PCRE Named Capture Groups for variable extraction.
fields.source_rule_redirect_help: For short links. When a post is saved, the server records the redirected URL and then applies direct recognition.
fields.embed_url_help: Use an HTTPS iframe embed URL or one beginning with //. Click to insert a variable:
fields.iframe_attributes_help: Use space-separated name='value' pairs. Only allow, referrerpolicy, allowfullscreen, scrolling, and height are supported. The allowfullscreen attribute may omit its value. When the aspect ratio is empty, a fixed height such as height='86' is required.
fields.aspect_ratio_help: Responsive ratio for the media player, such as 16 / 9. Leave it empty for a fixed-height player and set height in the iframe attributes.
fields.test_url_help: Tests the current unsaved rules with PHP PCRE. Short URLs are resolved by the server only when you start the test.
fields.sort_order_help: Used to order custom BBCode icons in the composer.

test.url_too_long: The test URL cannot exceed 2,000 characters.
test.missing_embed_capture: The embed URL must contain at least one named capture variable.
test.invalid_embed_url: The embed URL must use HTTPS or begin with //.
test.invalid_pattern: Source rule #{number} is not a valid PCRE with a literal hostname.
test.missing_pattern_capture: Direct recognition rule #{number} does not provide every variable used by the embed URL.
test.missing_extract_rule: Add at least one direct recognition rule.
test.empty_capture: Rule #{number} matched, but a required capture value was empty.
test.redirect_failed: Short URL rule #{number} matched, but the server could not resolve it to a supported direct URL.
test.no_match: The URL did not match any source rule.
test.request_failed: The test request failed. Check the connection and try again.

validation.usage_tag_mismatch: The BBCode usage opening and closing tags must exactly match the configured tag.
validation.example_attributes_object: Inserted attributes must be an object keyed by attribute name.
validation.example_attributes_limit: No more than 32 inserted attributes may be configured.
validation.example_attribute_text: Inserted attribute values must be text or empty.
validation.example_attribute_length: Inserted attribute values cannot exceed 500 characters.
validation.example_attribute_choice: The inserted value for {attribute} must be one of its declared choices.
validation.source_rules_array: Media source rules must be an array.
validation.source_rule_type: Media source rule #{number} has an invalid type.
validation.fixed_height_required: A fixed-height media rule must include a positive integer height, such as height='86'.
validation.aspect_ratio_positive: Both aspect-ratio values must be greater than zero.
validation.embed_capture_required: The embed URL must reference at least one named capture.
validation.extract_hostname_required: Extraction rule #{number} must contain at least one literal hostname.
validation.extract_capture_required: Extraction rule #{number} must contain at least one named capture.
validation.embed_capture_mismatch: Every embed URL placeholder must match a named capture in every extraction rule.
validation.extract_regexp_invalid: Extraction rule #{number} is not a valid regular expression.
validation.redirect_hostname_required: Short-link rule #{number} must contain at least one literal hostname.
validation.redirect_regexp_invalid: Short-link rule #{number} is not a valid regular expression.
validation.embed_url_https: The embed URL must use HTTPS or be protocol-relative.
validation.bbcode_definition_invalid: The BBCode usage or rendering template is invalid.
validation.template_attributes_undeclared: The rendering template references attributes not declared by the BBCode usage: {attributes}.
validation.media_definition_invalid: The media embed definition is invalid.
validation.built_in_delete: Built-in BBCode Studio templates cannot be deleted.
validation.styles_imports_unsupported: Less imports and plugins are not supported in custom BBCode styles.
validation.styles_unsafe_value: The custom styles contain an unsafe CSS value.
validation.styles_invalid: The custom Less styles are invalid.
validation.styles_close_scope: Custom styles cannot close the automatically generated class scope.
validation.styles_unclosed: The custom styles contain an unclosed comment, quote, or block.
validation.template_requires_element: The rendering template must output at least one HTML element so its automatic class can be applied.
validation.regexp_delimiter_required: The regular expression must use a delimiter.
validation.regexp_delimiter_unclosed: The regular expression delimiter is not closed.
validation.iframe_attribute_format: Iframe attributes must use the name or name='value' format.
validation.iframe_attribute_repeated: Iframe attribute "{attribute}" must not be repeated.
validation.iframe_attribute_requires_value: Iframe attribute "{attribute}" requires a quoted value.
validation.iframe_attribute_static_value: Iframe attribute values must be static text.
validation.iframe_attribute_quote_types: Iframe attribute values cannot contain both quote types.
